verse.verse_1: In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_2: Al-Hamd be to Allah, the Lord of all that exists.
verse.verse_3: Ar-Rahman (the Most Gracious), Ar-Rahim (the Most Merciful).
verse.verse_4: The Owner of the Day of Recompense.
verse.verse_5: You we worship, and You we ask for help.
verse.verse_6: Guide us to the straight path.
verse.verse_7: The way of those upon whom You have bestowed Your grace, not (that) of those who earned Your anger, nor of those who went astray.
